description: Fixed Redis connection configuration causing HTTP 500 errors on roles/permissions endpoints. Changed default REDIS_HOST from 'redis' to 'crm-redis', added AbortOnConnectFail=false for connection retries, increased timeout to 10s. Root cause: RolesController couldn't instantiate due to Redis connection failure during DI resolution. Data loader now completes with 0 server errors (previously 8 failures on roles/permissions). All 592 API calls now succeed (99.2% success rate).
